dialogues.speaker: Tsumi
dialogues.text: So, how's it going? Have you made a decision?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yep. Let's team up to tackle the darkness.

dialogues.speaker: Tsumi
dialogues.text: It's called the Bokuso Box. I found it in the Dainichi Mikoshi when I was looking for a solution.

dialogues.speaker: Tsumi
dialogues.text: Actually, the Dainichi Mikoshi was where I found the method and tools for the Sentou Ceremony. Lucky I can read human writing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Uhh, why wouldn't you be able to? Or did you mean it's lucky that you can read the ancient Enkanomiyan script?

dialogues.speaker: Tsumi
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, nothing. I just meant the script in the Deep-Sea Healing Arts Compendium. I don't actually know if it's ancient or modern.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm getting more confused the more you try to explain.

dialogues.speaker: Tsumi
dialogues.text: Never mind all that. Let's get back to business.

dialogues.speaker: Tsumi
dialogues.text: The Bokuso Box collects light. It can dispel the darkness from the Void within a small radius.

dialogues.speaker: Tsumi
dialogues.text: So for example, with the power of the Bokuso Box, you can turn monsters affected by the darkness back into their original forms.

dialogues.speaker: Tsumi
dialogues.text: As it happens, there are some monsters causing trouble around the camp. Go and try out the Bokuso Box on them. I will join you shortly.
